settings.html:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,400;12..96,500;12..96,600;12..96,700;12..96,800&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="nicu-styles">
/* ============================================================
   PREMIUM DESIGN SYSTEM — drshivdiggikar.com
   Modern Healthcare · Blue + White · 8px Grid
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  /* Core palette */
  --blue-950:  #04152d;
  --blue-900:  #0a2540;
  --blue-800:  #0d3660;
  --blue-700:  #1251a3;
  --blue-600:  #1a6ed8;
  --blue-500:  #2589ff;
  --blue-400:  #5aaeff;
  --blue-300:  #93cbff;
  --blue-100:  #deeeff;
  --blue-50:   #f0f8ff;

  /* Neutrals */
  --slate-900: #0f172a;
  --slate-800: #1e293b;
  --slate-700: #334155;
  --slate-600: #475569;
  --slate-500: #64748b;
  --slate-400: #94a3b8;
  --slate-200: #e2e8f0;
  --slate-100: #f1f5f9;
  --slate-50:  #f8fafc;
  --white:     #ffffff;

  /* Semantic */
  --text-primary:   var(--slate-900);
  --text-secondary: var(--slate-600);
  --text-muted:     var(--slate-400);
  --border:         var(--slate-200);
  --border-blue:    #c0d9f5;

  /* Gradients */
  --grad-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2540 0%, #1251a3 55%, #2589ff 100%);
  --grad-blue:    linear-gradient(135deg, #1251a3 0%, #2589ff 100%);
  --grad-subtle:  linear-gradient(180deg, #f0f8ff 0%, #ffffff 100%);
  --grad-card:    linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.9) 0%, rgba(240,248,255,0.6) 100%);

  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-xs:  0 1px 3px rgba(10,37,64,0.08);
  --shadow-sm:  0 2px 8px rgba(10,37,64,0.10), 0 1px 3px rgba(10,37,64,0.06);
  --shadow-md:  0 4px 20px rgba(10,37,64,0.12), 0 2px 6px rgba(10,37,64,0.06);
  --shadow-lg:  0 12px 40px rgba(10,37,64,0.16), 0 4px 12px rgba(10,37,64,0.08);
  --shadow-xl:  0 24px 64px rgba(10,37,64,0.20), 0 8px 24px rgba(10,37,64,0.10);
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 32px rgba(37,137,255,0.25);

  /* Radius */
  --r-sm:  8px;
  --r-md:  12px;
  --r-lg:  20px;
  --r-xl:  28px;
  --r-full: 999px;

  /* Spacing (8px system) */
  --sp-1: 8px; --sp-2: 16px; --sp-3: 24px; --sp-4: 32px;
  --sp-5: 40px; --sp-6: 48px; --sp-7: 64px; --sp-8: 80px;
  --sp-9: 96px; --sp-10: 120px;

  --transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --transition-slow: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* ── RESET ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
body {
  font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--white);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
button { font-family: inherit; }

/* ── LAYOUT ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.container {
  max-width: 1160px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 var(--sp-3);
}

/* ── TYPOGRAPHY ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
h1, h2, h3 {
  font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Inter', sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
h1 { font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 60px); font-weight: 800; }
h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 40px); font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate-900); }
h3 { font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 20px); font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate-900); }
p  { line-height: 1.75; color: var(--text-secondary); }
p:not(:last-child) { margin-bottom: 14px; }

/* ── SECTION CHROME ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.section-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--blue-600);
  background: var(--blue-50);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-blue);
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
}
.section-tag-white {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
}
.section-heading { margin-bottom: var(--sp-2); }
.section-sub {
  font-size: 17px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 600px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
}

/* ── BUTTONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px 28px;
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-decoration: none;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: var(--grad-blue);
  color: var(--white);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(37,137,255,0.35);
}
.btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(37,137,255,0.45);
}

.btn-white {
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--blue-700);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.btn-white:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.btn-ghost {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  color: var(--white);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.btn-ghost:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
}

.btn-outline-blue {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--blue-600);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-blue);
}
.btn-outline-blue:hover {
  background: var(--blue-50);
  border-color: var(--blue-600);
}

/* ── STICKY MOBILE CTA ───────────────────────────────────── */
.mobile-sticky-cta {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: 900;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  gap: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(10,37,64,0.12);
}
.mobile-sticky-cta .btn { flex: 1; padding: 13px 12px; font-size: 14px; }

/* ── HERO ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--blue-900);
}

.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
}
.hero-bg img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center 20%;
  opacity: 0.35;
}

/* Mesh gradient overlay */
.hero-overlay {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 20% 50%, rgba(18,81,163,0.85) 0%, transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 80% 20%, rgba(37,137,255,0.3) 0%, transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(4,21,45,0.95) 0%, rgba(10,37,64,0.75) 100%);
}

/* Decorative orbs */
.hero-orb {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}
.hero-orb-1 {
  width: 400px; height: 400px;
  top: -100px; right: -80px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(37,137,255,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
}
.hero-orb-2 {
  width: 300px; height: 300px;
  bottom: -60px; left: 10%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(18,81,163,0.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
}

.hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 96px 0 72px;
}

.hero-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px;
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
}

.hero-left {}

.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(37,137,255,0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(90,174,255,0.35);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  padding: 6px 16px 6px 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--blue-300);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.hero-badge-dot {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  background: #22c55e;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
}

.hero h1 {
  color: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-size: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 54px);
}
.hero h1 em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--blue-400);
}

.hero-desc {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
  max-width: 520px;
}

.hero-ctas {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.hero-trust {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.hero-trust-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.hero-trust-divider {
  width: 1px; height: 16px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}

/* Hero right — credential card */
.hero-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: 28px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
}
.hero-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.hero-avatar {
  width: 56px; height: 56px;
  background: var(--grad-blue);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 22px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(37,137,255,0.4);
}
.hero-card-name {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.hero-card-title {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
  margin-top: 3px;
}

.cred-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.cred-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  transition: background 0.2s;
}
.cred-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); }
.cred-item-icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--blue-400);
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}
.cred-item-text {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.cred-item-sub {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  margin-top: 2px;
  display: block;
}


/* ── ABOUT SECTION ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.about-section {
  padding: var(--sp-10) 0;
  background: var(--white);
}
.about-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 440px;
  gap: 72px;
  align-items: start;
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}
.about-text p {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.about-text p strong { color: var(--slate-800); }
.about-text p:not(:last-child) { margin-bottom: 18px; }

.about-highlights {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}
.highlight-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  background: var(--blue-50);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-blue);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--blue-800);
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.highlight-item:hover {
  background: var(--blue-100);
  transform: translateX(4px);
}
.highlight-icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--blue-600);
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}

/* About right sidebar */
.about-sidebar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 32px;
}
.profile-card {
  background: var(--grad-primary);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: 28px;
  color: var(--white);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.profile-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -40px; right: -40px;
  width: 180px; height: 180px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.profile-card::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -30px; left: -20px;
  width: 140px; height: 140px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.profile-name {
  font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  position: relative;
}
.profile-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  position: relative;
}
.profile-stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  position: relative;
}
.profile-stat {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  padding: 14px 12px;
  text-align: center;
}
.profile-stat-num {
  font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--white);
  line-height: 1;
}
.profile-stat-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  margin-top: 3px;
}


/* ── WHY SECTION ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.why-section {
  padding: var(--sp-10) 0;
  background: var(--grad-primary);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.why-section::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -120px; right: -80px;
  width: 500px; height: 500px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(37,137,255,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.why-section::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -100px; left: -60px;
  width: 400px; height: 400px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(18,81,163,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.why-section h2 { color: var(--white); }
.why-section .section-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }

.why-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
  position: relative;
}

.why-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 28px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  transition: var(--transition);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.why-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(90,174,255,0.5), transparent);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}
.why-card:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
}
.why-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

.why-icon {
  width: 48px; height: 48px;
  background: rgba(37,137,255,0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(90,174,255,0.25);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  color: var(--blue-300);
}
.why-card h3 {
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 17px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.why-card p {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68);
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin: 0;
}

/* ── CONDITIONS SECTION ──────────────────────────────────── */
.conditions-section {
  padding: var(--sp-10) 0;
  background: var(--slate-50);
}
.conditions-layout {
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
}
.accordion {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.accordion-item {
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
}
.accordion-item:hover { border-color: var(--border-blue); }
.accordion-item.is-open {
  border-color: var(--blue-600);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,137,255,0.08);
}
.accordion-header {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--slate-800);
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: var(--transition);
  gap: 12px;
  text-align: left;
}
.accordion-header:hover { background: var(--blue-50); }
.acc-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.acc-icon {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  background: var(--blue-50);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: background 0.2s;
  color: var(--blue-600);
}
.accordion-item.is-open .acc-icon { background: var(--blue-100); }
.acc-arrow {
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--slate-100);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: var(--transition);
  color: var(--slate-500);
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1;
}
.accordion-item.is-open .acc-arrow {
  background: var(--blue-600);
  color: var(--white);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.accordion-body {
  max-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: max-height 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.accordion-body.open { max-height: 520px; }
.accordion-body ul {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 8px 22px 22px 70px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.accordion-body ul li {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding-left: 18px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.accordion-body ul li::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; top: 9px;
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  background: var(--blue-400);
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.internal-links-block {
  margin-top: 24px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-blue);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--blue-600);
}
.internal-links-block p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0; }
.internal-links-block a { color: var(--blue-600); font-weight: 600; }

/* ── LOCATION SECTION ────────────────────────────────────── */
.location-section {
  padding: var(--sp-10) 0;
  background: var(--white);
}
.location-layout {
  margin-top: var(--sp-5);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 340px;
  gap: 28px;
  align-items: start;
}
.location-main-card {
  background: var(--white);

About the NICU Specialist

What is a NICU Specialist & Why Dr. Diggikar is Bangalore's Most Qualified Neonatologist

A NICU specialist in Bangalore, also called a neonatologist, is a pediatrician with advanced training in caring for the most vulnerable newborns — premature babies, those with low birth weight, respiratory distress, infections, or life-threatening complications in the first days and weeks of life.

Dr. Shivashankar Diggikar is a London-trained NICU specialist in Bangalore with dual UK and Ireland certifications (FRCPCH, FRCPI) — credentials held by very few neonatologists in India. As Director of Neonatal-Perinatal Services at Medicover Women & Children Hospital, Whitefield, Dr. Diggikar combines international NICU training from Homerton University Hospital London with over 15 years of hands-on experience managing India's most complex neonatal cases.

Unlike general pediatricians who treat healthy children, a NICU specialist focuses exclusively on critically ill newborns requiring intensive monitoring, ventilator support, phototherapy for jaundice, feeding tube management, and round-the-clock care. Dr. Diggikar's NICU expertise covers premature babies as early as 27–30 weeks gestation, neonatal sepsis, respiratory distress syndrome, congenital heart defects, neonatal brain injury, and low birth weight management.

What sets Dr. Diggikar apart as a NICU specialist in Bangalore is his research-backed approach to neonatal care. With 30+ publications in international pediatric journals and an editorial role at BMJ Paediatrics Open, he stays at the forefront of evidence-based NICU protocols proven to improve survival rates and long-term outcomes for critically ill newborns.

Conditions Treated

NICU Conditions Treated by Dr. Diggikar — Neonatal Intensive Care Specialist

Dr. Diggikar, as a NICU specialist in Bangalore, provides expert neonatal intensive care for critically ill and premature newborns.

Specialized care for babies born too early, with underdeveloped lungs, digestive systems, and immune function. CPAP support, surfactant therapy, and developmental monitoring until safe discharge.

Ventilator support, surfactant replacement therapy, and high-frequency ventilation for premature babies struggling to breathe due to insufficient lung surfactant production.

Phototherapy (blue light treatment) and exchange transfusion when bilirubin levels become dangerously high. 24/7 monitoring to prevent kernicterus (brain damage from severe jaundice).

Nutritional management with feeding tubes, parenteral nutrition (TPN), infection prevention protocols, and growth monitoring for underweight newborns requiring extended NICU stay.

Aggressive antibiotic treatment and supportive care for life-threatening bacterial, viral, or fungal infections in newborns with immature immune systems.

Therapeutic hypothermia (cooling therapy) for birth asphyxia, and neuro-protective care for intraventricular hemorrhage (brain bleeding) in premature babies.

Stabilization, echocardiography, and coordinated care with pediatric cardiology teams at Medicover Whitefield for babies born with structural heart abnormalities.

Nasogastric (NG) tube placement, orogastric (OG) tube feeding, parenteral nutrition (IV nutrition), and gradual oral feeding transition for babies unable to breastfeed or bottle-feed.

CPAP (Continuous Positive Airway Pressure), BiPAP, and mechanical ventilation for persistent breathing pauses, bradycardia (slow heart rate), and desaturation episodes.

Expert neonatal resuscitation immediately after delivery for babies who are not breathing or have low Apgar scores. Available 24/7 for high-risk deliveries at Medicover Whitefield.
